reason: The README describes host-side DeepSeek Harness plugins whose primary user-facing purpose is native web search and scraping, with an additional image-understanding tool and installation-time profile configuration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供原生网页搜索、网页抓取和可配置的图像理解工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native web search, webpage scraping, and configurable image understanding tools.

capabilities: Provides agent tools for web search and scraping through a configured self-hosted Firecrawl-compatible HTTP service
Sends image inputs to a configured Responses API-compatible multimodal model endpoint
Reads configured API keys and local image files
Installs plugins and modifies DeepSeek Harness profiles and agent presets
Can optionally restart the DeepSeek Harness web profile
